invariants.text: Book.book_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Member.member_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Loan.loan_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Loan.member_id must reference an existing Member.member_id
Loan.book_id must reference an existing Book.book_id
A book's availability status must be either 'available' or 'checked out'.
A loan record must have a member_id that corresponds to an existing member in the Member table.
A loan record must have a book_id that corresponds to an existing book in the Book table.
If a book is loaned out, its availability_status must be updated to 'checked out'.
When a loan is returned, the book's availability_status must be updated to 'available'.
A member can only loan a book if their membership_status is active.
A loan record must have a loan_date and a return_date, with the return_date being on or after the loan_date.
